high_level_description: This image is a social media post from the Instagram account "carplorer," which has the handle "Masterstroke." The post compares two Mahindra vehicles, specifically the Masterstroke model, to highlight the changes in car models over time for the same price point. Top Image: The top image shows a Mahindra Masterstroke from 2012. The text overlay reads, "WHAT YOU GOT FOR 12 LAKHS IN 2012."
